note: E6: ground patterns, painted into the ground vertex colours only (no geometry, no shader). Runs only with features.enabled on; anything else is today's ground exactly. Region by region: this slice is Meadow field patches (a quilt of irregular fields, each a slightly different green). 'regions' is the strength per region (0 = untouched, so only Meadow changes now). Fields are the cells of a jittered grid ('cell' m, 'jitter' 0..0.5 of a cell); each field takes one tint from 'tints' and mixes 'strength' of it into the ground colour. 'homeEase' m: the patches fade to nothing at the edge of the Home square. Metres. Guesses, tuned by eye.
